messages:
olivia: Heads-up  co-hosted booth demo with SkyBridge at Summit next Fri 11:00am PT. Format: 8m partner overview, 22m live hardware + marketplace integration, 10m audience Q&A. We need a full tech + stage run at Thu 3:30pm PT. Who can join?

peter: I can do Thu 3:30pm. I'll validate marketplace provisioning and the demo device handshake to our private endpoint. Also need SkyBridge redirect URI to whitelist for OIDC.

jin: Swag update: 160 attendee kits (sticker sheet, patch, insulated bottle). 58 kits to EU; customs value $19/kit. Courier pickup Wed 18:00, on-site pack Thu 08:00. I'll upload manifest + pro-formas to the partner drive.

tara: Tech notes: SkyBridge will call our hosted API then expect fallback to Dedicated Edge when latency > 300ms. They also do an on-device demo that needs a reserved local subnet and static leases. Can we reserve 10 IPs in 10.50.5.0/28?

olivia: Peter, paste the SkyBridge redirect URI so I can add to staging allowlist. Also we should prepare a short printed cue for the partner about fallback wording.

peter: Redirect URI: https://connect.skybridge.io/oauth/return. Added to staging allowlist. I'll draft fallback phrasing: "If the hosted path is congested, we switch to our Dedicated Edge pool transparently; the demo resumes in under 2s."

jin: Courier-bot: confirm pickup window and that customs forms are attached for the 58 EU kits.

courier-bot: Pickup scheduled Wed 18:00 local. Manifest and customs forms uploaded to drive. Tracking numbers will be posted by 20:00. :truck: 

tara: For the dry-run Thu 3:30pm let's run this failover smoke on staging (we'll use a short-lived demo token):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference/api/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer demo-sky-183333' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-hosted-edge","prompt":"skybridge preflight","max_tokens":12,"simulate_load":true}'
```
Expect routing to hosted then fallback to `redwood-edge-dedicated`. Watch `routing-decisions` and `edge-handshakes`.

peter: I'll create a 6-hour demo token and DM the SkyBridge speaker 10 minutes before the dry-run. Also will ensure a scoped webhook is provisioned for provisioning events (rotate secret after).

jin: On-site asks: table + lockbox for high-value swag, power strip, and a small 8-port switch. Also need a volunteer for kit QA at 9:00am Fri. Who's available?

olivia: I can do kit QA at 9:00am. Jin, please share the packing manifest link here when uploaded.

jin: Uploaded: https://drive.internal/partners/skybridge-swag-manifest (internal). QA checklist attached in the folder.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run Thu 15:10 (1833336600). I will ping this channel 20 minutes before. :bell:

peter: Dry-run agenda (Thu 15:30, 30m):
- 15:30 join backstage Zoom (hosted link)
- 15:33 OIDC & demo token smoke (5m)
- 15:38 marketplace provisioning + webhook test (7m)
- 15:46 induce hosted->dedicated fallback & observe logs (10m)
- 15:56 speaker cue + slide handoff (3m)
- 15:59 final swag manifest & QA assignment (2m)

tara: One more request  can SRE mute SLO alerts for the booth region 10:30-12:30 PT Fri? We will create temporary quota profile for the demo.

olivia: I'll file the SLO mute request after the dry-run if the failover tests look clean. Thanks everyone  let's lock the runbook if no blockers by EOD tomorrow. :raised_hands:
